# Dedication

Dedication is a customizable dark and light theme with extensive color and typography controls. Six presets or a custom palette can be used, H1 through H6 colors and adaptive accents are set individually, and explorer folders, tables, checkboxes and the calendar are styled to match.

![Dedication screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/modigaphemelo/Dedication-obsidian-theme/HEAD/Dark.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Dedication"
    author: "modigaphemelo"
    repo:   "modigaphemelo/Dedication-obsidian-theme"
    slug:   "dedication"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/dedication"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/modigaphemelo/Dedication-obsidian-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/modigaphemelo/Dedication-obsidian-theme/HEAD/Dark.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a customizable dark/light theme with extensive color and typography controls. Pick from six presets or craft a custom palette, set individual H1–H6 colors and adaptive accents, and style explorer folders, tables, checkboxes, and calendar for a cohesive look."
}
```
